children: SPCX and Tesla are advancing merger talks, with a deal announcement possible by December or talks extending into early 2027. Boards are weighing share exchange terms, ownership and governance.
SpaceX (SPCX) reported $14.6 billion in quarterly revenue, including $7.6 billion from AI, up 830% year over year. Growth came largely from AI computing and cloud deals and increased Grok use.
SPCX’s 15th uncrewed Starship test reached orbit 27 minutes after launch, but the Super Heavy booster missed its planned Texas tower recovery and exploded over the Gulf of Mexico.
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said a merger with Tesla could create synergies in AI, chips, robotics and orbital computing. Independent board committees are reviewing the proposal; Musk will not take part.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) said Starship reached orbit and deployed 26 Starlink satellites. The vehicle was set to orbit Earth about 14 times before an attempted tower-arm catch.
- Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) shares fell more than 1% in after-hours trading on November 13 following a failed Super Heavy booster recovery.
U.S. senators asked SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to preserve records on reported Starlink and Starshield restrictions in Ukraine, citing potential vulnerabilities and disruptions to military communications.
Ukraine said Starshield restrictions since Thursday remain unexplained. President Zelensky asked officials to seek clarification from U.S. agencies and SpaceX (SPCX).
Freedom Capital strategist Jay Woods said a SpaceX-Tesla merger could face political hurdles if Democrats control Congress in 2027, adding the companies are distinct and deal details remain unclear.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) said it could currently produce one Starship vehicle every two weeks and one Super Heavy booster every four weeks.
